# electerm release archive

> The complete archive of every electerm release: 582 versions published between 2017-11-29 and 2026-09-21, each with its original release notes and its original download files, kept permanently downloadable.

## What this site is

This is **history.electerm.org**, the electerm release archive. Its single purpose is to keep every electerm release ever published available for download, long after it has been superseded.

It is **not** the electerm product site. For the current release, documentation, downloads of the latest version and support, use [https://electerm.org](https://electerm.org). Anything on this archive is a historical version — useful for pinning an old version, reproducing a bug on a specific build, or installing on a machine that cannot run the current release.

What each page gives you:

- The release notes exactly as published for that version (bilingual: English and Chinese, as upstream wrote them).
- The original asset files for that version, grouped by platform and CPU architecture, with the file size and a short description of what each file is for.
- A direct link to the file on GitHub Releases, plus a mirror link for networks where GitHub is slow or blocked.

## Pages

- [Home](https://history.electerm.org/) — what the archive is, the newest release, and the most recent versions.
- [All releases](https://history.electerm.org/releases/) — every version, newest first, grouped by year.
- [A specific version](https://history.electerm.org/releases/v5.5.25/) — release notes and download files for one version. This is the page shape to link to; replace `v5.5.25` with any version tag.
- [Sitemap](https://history.electerm.org/sitemap.xml) — every version page on the site.

There are no other page types. Blog, FAQ, video guides, about, sponsor, terms and privacy pages are **not** on this site — they live at [https://electerm.org](https://electerm.org).

## Downloading a specific version

Every version page is `/releases/<version>/`, where `<version>` is the upstream git tag, e.g. `v5.5.25`. Tags look like `v5.5.25` for releases from v3.x onward and like `1.13.4` for some very old ones; the archive uses the tag exactly as published.

The underlying files are the upstream GitHub release assets, so their URLs are predictable:

```
https://github.com/electerm/electerm/releases/download/<version>/<filename>
```

Asset filenames embed the version and the target, for example:

- `electerm-5.5.25-linux-amd64.deb`, `electerm-5.5.25-linux-aarch64.rpm`, `electerm-5.5.25-linux-amd64.snap`
- `electerm-5.5.25-linux-arm64-legacy.AppImage` — `-legacy` builds target glibc < 2.34 (e.g. Ubuntu 18, UOS, Kylin)
- `electerm-5.5.25-mac-arm64.dmg`, `electerm-5.5.25-mac-x64.dmg`, `electerm-5.5.25-mac10-x64.dmg`
- `electerm-5.5.25-win-x64.exe`, `electerm-5.5.25-win-arm64.exe`, `electerm-5.5.25-win7-x64.exe`

For networks where `github.com` is slow or unreachable, the same file is mirrored by prefixing the GitHub URL with `https://mirror.electerm.org/`:

```
https://mirror.electerm.org/https://github.com/electerm/electerm/releases/download/<version>/<filename>
```

Android builds are published from the separate [electerm-android](https://github.com/electerm/electerm-android) repository and are merged onto the matching version page. Only a minority of versions (12 of the 582) have Android builds.

## About electerm

electerm is an open-source terminal / file manager and SSH / SFTP / FTP / Telnet / serialport / RDP / VNC / Spice client, supporting Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, HarmonyOS and iOS.

Besides the mainstream Windows / macOS / Linux / Android platforms, electerm also supports HarmonyOS, iOS, and older systems such as Ubuntu 18, Windows 7, macOS 10+, as well as domestic Linux distributions like UOS and Kylin, LoongArch (both old-world and new-world), RISC-V (riscv64) and PowerPC 64-bit little-endian (ppc64le) Linux.

## Key features

- Works as a terminal / file manager or an SSH / SFTP / FTP / Telnet / serialport / RDP / VNC / Spice client
- Supports Windows 7+ (X64/ARM64), HarmonyOS, Android, iOS, macOS 10.15+ (X64/arm64), Linux (X64/arm64/armv7/LoongArch64/RISC-V/ppc64le), and older systems with glibc 2.17+
- Global hotkey to toggle window visibility (similar to guake, default `ctrl + 2`)
- Multi-language support (Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, French, and more, see [electerm-locales](https://github.com/electerm/electerm-locales), contributions/fixes welcome)
- Double-click to directly edit small remote files
- Public key + password authentication
- Zmodem (rz, sz) and Trzsz (trz/tsz) support, compatible with tmux, see [Trzsz](https://github.com/trzsz/trzsz)
- SSH tunnel and global / session proxy support
- Terminal background image and transparent window
- Quick commands, UI / terminal themes
- Sync bookmarks / themes / quick commands to GitHub / Gitee secret gist, WebDAV, a custom server, or electerm cloud
- Integrated AI assistant for command suggestions, script writing, explaining selected content, and creating bookmarks / themes
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) widget for AI assistant and external tool integration - see [MCP Widget Usage Guide](https://github.com/electerm/electerm/wiki/MCP-Widget-Usage-Guide)
- Deep link support, e.g. `ssh://user@host:22`, `telnet://192.168.2.31:34554` - see [Deep link support wiki](https://github.com/electerm/electerm/wiki/Deep-link-support)
- Command-line usage - see [wiki](https://github.com/electerm/electerm/wiki/Command-line-usage)

## Install the current version

These install the **latest** release, not an archived one:

- macOS: `brew install --cask electerm`
- Linux (snap): `sudo snap install electerm --classic`
- Windows: Microsoft Store, winget (`winget install electerm.electerm`), or Scoop
- npm: `npm i -g electerm`

To install a specific archived version instead, download the file from that version's page at `/releases/<version>/`.
